title: Samsung-backed Element showcases next-gen DNA sequencing tech in Seoul
caption:
Element Biosciences is rolling out new DNA sequencing tech that could drop the cost of a human genome to just $100. Their latest devices, Vitari and Cytos, are designed to make high-throughput genomic research faster and more accessible for scientists worldwide.

Source: Koreaherald - Samsung-backed Element showcases next-gen DNA sequencing tech in Seoul
